[Previous context: Complying with the
EU environmental acquis, promoting efficient use of natural resources, preserving biodiversity, and enhancing tourism

opportunities are increasingly important to furthering national development.] The main objective of the Green Growth and Climate Change Analytic and Advisory Support Program is to provide
integrated analytic work and non-lending technical assistance across multiple sectors. The Program supports the
Government in (i) assessing the economic costs and benefits of a shift to greener growth, taking into account projected
climate change; and with this knowledge, (ii) prioritizing for implementation actions identified by the National Strategy for

Sustainable Development (NSSD) and supplemented by the Program's recommendations.
